label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows to 'target' variable, which is used in new java.net.URL(target).openConnection() at line 25. Although there are guards (startsWith https:// check, InetAddress validation), the resolved sink value still depends on attacker-controlled input. The guards are insufficient - they validate the resolved address type but don't sanitize the original target string, allowing path manipulation attacks through the URL constructor.

evidence.note: User input param -> target -> URL(target).openConnection() sink; guards validate resolved address but not original target string content
